string-array.name: tips_chest_press
string-array.item: Don\'t let your elbows flare straight out. Keep them about 45° from your body.
Stagger your feet and brace. If the cable pulls you back, take a step forward.
Press out, not up. Your hands finish in front of your chest, not your face.
Keep your shoulders down and back. No shrugging as you press!
Control the way back. Don\'t let the weight yank your arms behind you.

string-array.name: tips_chest_fly
string-array.item: Soft elbows! Locking your arm out loads the joint instead of your chest.
Hug a big tree. The bend in your elbow shouldn\'t change during the rep.
Don\'t twist your body to drag the handle across. Stay square.
Squeeze your chest in the middle and pause for a second.
Go lighter than you think. Flys are about the stretch, not the weight.

string-array.name: tips_high_to_low_fly
string-array.item: Sweep down and across toward your opposite hip, not straight down.
Lean forward a little from your hips and keep your chest proud.
Don\'t bend your elbow more as you pull. That turns it into a press.
Keep your shoulder down. Shrugging takes the work off your chest.
Slow on the way back up. Feel the stretch across your chest.

string-array.name: tips_low_to_high_fly
string-array.item: Scoop up and across to about chin height. Higher hands it to your shoulders.
Keep a soft bend in your elbow. Don\'t curl the handle up.
Don\'t lean back to swing it. Your body stays still.
Squeeze your upper chest, right under your collarbone.
Keep your palm facing up as you lift.

string-array.name: tips_row
string-array.item: Lead with your elbows. Pull them back past your ribs, not just your hands.
Don\'t rock back and forth. Let your back do the pulling.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end and hold for a beat.
Shoulders down, away from your ears. No shrugging!
Let your arms straighten all the way out for the stretch.

string-array.name: tips_lat_pulldown
string-array.item: Pull your elbows down to your sides, like tucking them into your back pockets.
Don\'t lean way back. A slight lean is fine, but this isn\'t a row.
Pull to your upper chest, never behind your neck.
Let your arms go all the way up for the stretch, then pull your shoulders down first.
Don\'t yank with your arms. Your back starts every rep.

string-array.name: tips_straight_arm_pulldown
string-array.item: Keep your arms almost straight. Bending them turns this into a pushdown.
Hinge forward a little and keep your back flat.
Sweep down in an arc to your thighs. Think lats, not triceps.
Don\'t let your shoulders roll forward at the bottom.
Slow on the way up. Feel the stretch along your sides.

string-array.name: tips_lateral_raise
string-array.item: Lead with your elbow, not your hand, like pouring water from a jug.
Stop at shoulder height. Going higher hands the work to your traps.
No swinging! If your body moves, the weight is too heavy.
Keep your shoulder down. Shrugging steals the work from your delts.
Lower it slowly. The way down builds muscle too.

string-array.name: tips_front_raise
string-array.item: Raise to shoulder height and no higher.
Don\'t lean back to swing it up. Keep your core tight.
Keep a soft bend in your elbow. Don\'t lock it out.
Breathe out as you lift, then lower slowly.
Stand tall. Rounding forward turns this into a shrug.

string-array.name: tips_face_pull
string-array.item: Pull toward your forehead, not your chin. Elbows high!
Pull the rope apart as it comes in, so your hands end beside your ears.
Don\'t lean back to move more weight. Light and strict wins here.
Squeeze your upper back and hold for a second at the end.
Keep your neck neutral. Don\'t poke your chin toward the rope.

string-array.name: tips_triceps_pushdown
string-array.item: Pin your elbows to your sides. If they move, it\'s a press, not a pushdown.
Don\'t lean over the rope to push it down. Stand tall.
Straighten your arms fully and squeeze your triceps at the bottom.
Don\'t let it fly back up. Control it to chest height.
Keep your wrists straight, not bent back.

string-array.name: tips_overhead_triceps_extension
string-array.item: Keep your elbows pointing forward. Don\'t let them flare out wide.
Your upper arms stay still. Only your forearms move.
Get a deep stretch behind your head before you extend.
Brace your core so your lower back doesn\'t arch.
Stagger your stance. You\'ll be much steadier.

string-array.name: tips_triceps_kickback
string-array.item: Keep your upper arm level with the floor and pinned to your side.
Don\'t swing it. Your elbow is the only joint that moves.
Straighten all the way and squeeze for a second.
Keep your back flat, not rounded.
Go lighter. Kickbacks punish ego lifting!

string-array.name: tips_biceps_curl
string-array.item: Elbows stay at your sides. Don\'t let them drift forward.
No hip swing! If your body rocks, drop the weight.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly. Don\'t just let it drop.
Keep your wrists straight. Curling them in cheats your biceps.
Straighten your arms fully at the bottom for the whole stretch.

string-array.name: tips_high_cable_curl
string-array.item: Keep your upper arm level. Don\'t let your elbow sag.
Curl the handle toward your ear, like flexing in the mirror.
Don\'t lean toward the machine to shorten the pull.
Pause and squeeze at the top. That peak is the whole point.
Let your arm straighten slowly on the way back.

string-array.name: tips_behind_back_curl
string-array.item: Let your arm hang behind you for a big stretch at the bottom.
Keep your elbow back. Don\'t let it swing forward to help.
Step out far enough that the cable stays tight the whole time.
Stand tall. No bowing forward to finish the rep.
Go slow on the way down. The stretch is where this one shines.

string-array.name: tips_glute_kickback
string-array.item: Kick back with your heel, not your toes, to feel it in your glutes.
Don\'t arch your lower back to get the leg higher.
Keep your hips square. Don\'t twist them open.
Squeeze your glute at the top and hold for a second.
Hold the machine and keep your standing knee soft.

string-array.name: tips_pull_through
string-array.item: Hinge at the hips. Push your butt back, don\'t squat down.
Keep your arms straight. They\'re just hooks; your hips do the work.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes at the top.
Don\'t lean back at the top. Stand tall and stop.
Keep your back flat the whole time. No rounding.

string-array.name: tips_cable_crunch
string-array.item: Curl your ribs toward your hips. Don\'t just bow from the hips.
Keep your hips still. If your butt moves back, your abs aren\'t doing it.
Hold the rope by your head. Don\'t pull it down with your arms.
Breathe out hard as you crunch down.
Control the way up. Don\'t let the stack yank you upright.

string-array.name: tips_woodchopper
string-array.item: Turn through your torso, not just your arms.
Pivot your back foot as you turn. Your knees will thank you.
Keep your arms nearly straight. They just guide the handle.
Control the return. Don\'t let the cable spin you back.
Brace your core like someone is about to poke your stomach.
